raw_segments.text: Duke, that face of his I do remember well. Yet when I saw it last it was besmeared as
black as Vulcan, in the smoke of war. A bobbling vessel was he captain of, for shallow draft
and bulk unprizable, with which such scathful grapple did he make with the most noble bottom
